Name: Custom NPC Name - Mobile
Author: anniekureko
Description:
How Use ?
> edit on content.json -> "Entries"

"#1":"adult/neutral/outgoing/neutral/man/datable/null/Other////#2"

#1 is Name NPC
#2 is New Name NPC

Example
"Abigail": "adult/neutral/outgoing/neutral/man/datable/null/Other////Annie-Kureko"

If error?
Please check ->  ,  <-- after the option
Example
"Abigail": "adult/neutral/outgoing/neutral/man/datable/null/Other////Annie-Kureko",
"Jas": "adult/neutral/outgoing/neutral/man/datable/null/Other////Chara"

Why all is man
> Developer Use copy and paste but It does not affect in game
